evidence: Enumerated every value the judge is told to create. (1) Nearly all mutation probes are judge-chosen and explicitly uniquified: gate criterion hro_gate_shared (gates/constraints/judge.toml:23) requires 'a unique title', 'a unique name, a unique email address'; functional prompt.md:11 and :15 'unique title (add a short suffix for this review)', 'suffix every title and name for this review', 'never rely on starting counts'; polish/prompt.md:11,14 and visual/prompt.md:11 same. Jobs J1/J2/J3 and cards A-F, V-Z, A2 are therefore new suffixed records; seed has only jobs 'Platform Engineer', 'Data Analyst', 'Product Designer' (seed_data.json:82-107), so no suffixed probe can collide. (2) The only literal probe values in criteria/prompts are 'Call back on Fri' (polish/judge.toml:23, offered as an example unfinished note) and tomas.varga@candidates.example (functional prompt.md:39). Grep of seed JSON, solution src and public markup finds no 'Call back'/'on Fri'; reference UI has no prefilled values (only placeholders 'Reason for rejecting', board.js:21,216). Tomas's email is in the seed (seed_data.json:72 user, :185 APP-201 on Data Analyst) by design; it is the account-link mechanism, not a pre-satisfied outcome: hro_candidate_linked (functional/judge.toml:398) requires 'the card added with Tomas's account email' to become his application, i.e. a new card on the uniquely titled J2, which the seeded Data Analyst application cannot satisfy; the prompt even guards an already-present address ('if that address is already on J2, open a new job J3', prompt.md:39). (3) Seeded artefacts that resemble graded outcomes are not used as evidence: the seeded rejection with reason (APP-301, seed:221-226) and seeded notes (seed:1020-1038) are on seeded jobs, while hro_reject_reason/hro_reopen/hro_notes grade the judge's own J1 cards; activity is not seeded (db.js seedIfEmpty inserts only users/jobs/applications/messages/reads/notes, lines 66-84), so hro_activity lines must come from the review's actions; adding a candidate inserts no automatic message (index.js:228 vs only message insert at :412), so Tomas's new J2 conversation starts empty and the T/U messages are new. (4) Seeded values used as baselines (Lena's 1 unread from reads seed:1066-1069; Noor's 120 messages) are read-only fixtures that criteria grade relative to (hro_unread_counts 'rises by exactly two', hro_thread_latest/earlier), not mutation probes. Plausible broken app: one that ignores account-email linking would still show Tomas his seeded Data Analyst application, but hro_candidate_linked names the added J2 card, so it fails correctly. Conforming alternative: an app that pre-populates nothing is unaffected because no criterion expects any probe value to exist before creation. Minor observation (no defect, P3 at most): hro_msg_exchange/T does not require distinctive message text, so on the fallback path (Tomas's seeded Data Analyst conversation, prompt.md:39) a judge-chosen generic text could in principle coincide with a seeded body; the prompt's 'counts read relative to their values before you act' and seeded bodies being specific sentences (seed:977-994) make this unlikely. Mechanical check-probe-not-in-seed.py was not executed (private checker); this is a manual source application of its documented behaviour, sufficient for this source-decidable row. No runtime evidence required for this row.
